Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Default field with helper text -->
<div class="hisd-input-text">
  <label class="hisd-input-text__label" for="full-name">Full name</label>
  <div class="hisd-input-text__control">
    <input
      class="hisd-input-text__field"
      type="text"
      id="full-name"
      name="full-name"
      placeholder="e.g. Ada Lovelace"
      aria-describedby="full-name-help">
  </div>
  <p class="hisd-input-text__helper" id="full-name-help">
    As it appears on your district ID.
  </p>
</div>

<!-- Error state: add .is-error, aria-invalid="true", and link the message -->
<div class="hisd-input-text is-error">
  <label class="hisd-input-text__label" for="email">Email address</label>
  <div class="hisd-input-text__control">
    <input
      class="hisd-input-text__field"
      type="email"
      id="email"
      name="email"
      aria-invalid="true"
      aria-describedby="email-error">
  </div>
  <p class="hisd-input-text__error" id="email-error" role="alert">
    Enter a valid email address, like name@hisd.org.
  </p>
</div>
